data.disagreement_analysis: The initial disagreement was triggered because qwen failed to audit the PKGBUILD due to an HTTP 400 API error, resulting in an inconclusive package verdict. coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to audit the PKGBUILD due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400), which caused the tool to mark the entire package as inconclusive.
learnings: The audit tool should handle transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) on individual files more gracefully. Failing a single file audit should not necessarily cascade to an inconclusive package verdict if the error is clearly a transient API issue rather than a content parsing failure, or the tool should implement a retry mechanism for failed file audits.
